subject: Civil Engineering Technician application, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello LGC Traffic Management team,

I'm applying for the Civil Engineering Technician role in Midvale that I saw on SEEK.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in AutoCAD and Civil 3D, and coursework on Austroads guides and AS 1742.14. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (2019). From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge, doing site inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring and keeping site records.

Your advert asks for a civil diploma and AutoCAD to prepare traffic guidance schemes and support site inspections, permits and project records, which fits where I want to start. I'm based in Melton VIC and open to discussing relocation to Perth. I hold an Australian driver's licence, a White Card and full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I haven't worked in traffic management or used GIS or Main Roads WA standards on a job yet, so I would start at junior level.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. Could we arrange a time to talk?

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

letter.greeting: Dear LGC Traffic Management Hiring Team,
paragraphs: I am applying for the Civil Engineering Technician role in Midvale advertised on SEEK. Preparing traffic guidance schemes and supporting the planning, design and site side of temporary traffic management is a practical way to start my civil career in Australia.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute in Australia. I prepared and reviewed technical drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D for road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage, applying Austroads guides and Australian Standards including AS 1742.14, and prepared cost estimates, bills of quantities and risk registers. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019).

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. I carried out site inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring, escalated issues that needed corrective action, and prepared site reports, material records and progress reports while coordinating with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers.

I hold an Australian driver's licence and a White Card, and I have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am based in Melton VIC and open to discussing relocation to Perth. I have not yet worked in traffic management or used GIS software or Main Roads WA standards on a job, so I would start at junior level and learn your systems quickly.
I have attached my resume and would welcome the chance to talk about the role.
